card: Pause a property game and keep the deeds in place.
title: RentParty when the game has to pause
intro: RentParty keeps a property game ready to resume. One phone, CPU players or an online room are different ways into the same board.

sections.heading: What kind of game is RentParty?
sections.body: It is a property-trading game that lets you stop and return.

sections.heading: How can people play?
sections.body: Pass one phone around, play against CPU characters, or use an online room.

sections.heading: What stays in place when play pauses?
sections.body: The game handles the bank and keeps deeds where they were when play resumes.

sections.heading: Where does RentParty fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell keeps the moments you share with people. RentParty is a game to play together, then pause until everyone can return.
